name: jr-claude-toolkit
description: Plugins de produtividade para Claude Code: skills, agents, commands e hooks.

plugins.name: code-review
plugins.description: Fast, focused review of uncommitted changes, a guided PR reading tour, plus a security-focused subagent.

plugins.name: model-router
plugins.description: Recommends the cheapest model, effort level, and execution shape that will complete a task reliably, from versioned per-provider routing policies (Anthropic and OpenAI) and a project-local calibration log.

plugins.name: git-narrator
plugins.description: Re-narrates a feature branch before merge: rebuilds messy exploratory history into a semantic commit sequence, with a byte-identical final tree and per-commit build gates.

plugins.name: comment-curator
plugins.description: Lifecycle review of code comments: verifies them against the code they describe, deletes noise, keeps load-bearing constraints. Diff-scoped by default, path-scoped on demand.

plugins.name: repo-governance
plugins.description: Plans and applies a repeatable GitHub repository standard: protected linear history, PR-only integration, automatic Copilot review, and optional quality gates.

plugins.name: sessions
plugins.description: Session organization helpers: distills the current session into a short, searchable resume handle and hands back the /rename command to apply it.

plugins.name: devops-tools
plugins.description: Pre-deploy checklist, changelog generation, and a guard hook against destructive shell commands.
